Messages.Author: Matt Latham
Messages.Body:
Card Text:

Spying Mission [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Action modifier

Discipline: Obfuscate

[obf] This acting vampire gets +1 stealth.
[OBF] Only usable [when a bleed is successful]. Instead of removing pool
from the Methuselah you're bleeding, put this card on the acting vampire.
The next time this vampire successfully bleeds the same Methuselah, burn
this card for +2 bleed.

Can a vampire have more than one of these active on him at any one time? I
read the errata that they have to be burned on the next successful bleed
action, but it seems you can daisy-chain them (ie make the bleed
unsuccessful via spying mission, get one one, make the next one
unsuccessful, get another and so on). As long as you never get a successful
bleed action through you can keep stacking these up. Is this correct?

Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, since playing Spying Mission reduces the bleed to zero, the previous
Spying Missions won't be cashed in.
